questions.stem: An object has a negative acceleration. What does this mean?

options.text: The object's velocity is decreasing (or increasing in the negative direction)

questions.explanation: Negative acceleration (deceleration) means the velocity is changing in the negative direction. This could mean the object is slowing down if moving in the positive direction, or speeding up if moving in the negative direction.

questions.stem: A bus decelerates from 20 m/s to rest in 8 seconds. What is the magnitude of its deceleration?
questions.explanation: Deceleration = change in velocity / time = (20 - 0) / 8 = 2.5 m/s². The deceleration is 2.5 m/s² (the acceleration would be -2.5 m/s²).
